grade3_math_proficient.label: Third graders proficient in math (proficient or above on the state math test)
grade3_math_proficient.source: Georgia Governor's Office of Student Achievement (GOSA), Georgia Milestones End-of-Grade results; NCES Common Core of Data for school system counties
grade3_math_proficient.note: Share of tested third graders who scored Proficient or Distinguished on the Georgia Milestones math test. County figures combine the county school system, any city school systems in the county and in-person state charter schools, weighted by the number of students tested; virtual state charter schools and systems too small for GOSA to report are left out. Fewer students tested in 2020-2021. The Georgia figure is built the same way from the same systems so counties compare on equal terms; GOSA's own statewide figure, which counts every school, was 44.3% in 2024-2025. In 2024-2025, 7 counties tested fewer than 30 third graders, so their figures can swing a lot from year to year. Georgia began testing new math standards in 2023-2024, so earlier years may not compare.

chronic_absent_rate.label: Students chronically absent (missed 10% or more of school)
chronic_absent_rate.source: Georgia Governor's Office of Student Achievement (GOSA), attendance files; NCES Common Core of Data for school system counties
chronic_absent_rate.note: Share of students absent more than 10% of the days they were enrolled, for any reason, excused or not. County figures cover county and city school systems only, weighted by GOSA's student count; state charter schools are left out. The Georgia figure is built the same way from all county and city systems; GOSA's own statewide figure, which counts every school, was 20.4% in 2024-2025. 2019-2020 is left out because school buildings closed in March 2020.
